claims.text: A previous Distilled communication regarding advertisements promoting Donald Trump and his policies potentially violating US laws that bar public government funds from being spent on political advertising has been withdrawn. The source reporting this was not necessarily retracted. The approved fact is that these ads could have violated such laws, and Trump has said he will stop using taxpayer funds for ads following bipartisan pushback.
